picks.title: Bill Gurley, Jack Altman back startup Pursuit, which helps companies sell to government
picks.why_it_matters: GovTech is heating up as top-tier VCs signal conviction in the space—early-stage founders solving government procurement pain points now have clear proof of market appetite and a potential acquirer/partnership path.

picks.title: Firestorm Labs raises $82M to take drone factories into the field
picks.why_it_matters: Defense tech continues attracting significant capital for distributed manufacturing solutions, validating the thesis that modular, deployable production infrastructure is a fundable category beyond traditional defense primes.

picks.title: BMW i Ventures has a new $300M fund and AI is riding shotgun
picks.why_it_matters: Corporate venture arms with fresh capital and explicit focus on agentic AI, physical AI, and industrial software represent both co-investment opportunities and strategic acquirer signals for founders in these verticals.
